JOYSTAR Rowland Kids' BMX Style Bike - 14" to 20"
Unleash their inner adventurer with the JOYSTAR Rowland Kids' Bike. Designed with a rugged BMX aesthetic and built for performance, this bike provides the perfect balance of cool styling and essential safety for riders aged 3 to 12 years old.

Rugged BMX performance: The JOYSTAR Rowland in Electric Blue.

Shine Like a Star
"Premium Electrostatic Paint. Glossy, scratch-resistant finish that stays vibrant for years."
Every JOYSTAR Rowland is finished with high-grade electrostatic paint. This advanced coating ensures a deep, glossy shine that isn't just for looks—it provides a durable, scratch-resistant barrier that keeps the bike looking brand new through every tumble and sidewalk race.
Product Details & Features

Close-up: Explore the premium engineering and finish of the Rowland series.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered for durability and control, the Rowland's reinforced frame and dual-braking system give young riders the confidence to push their limits safely."
Superior Safety Systems
The JOYSTAR Rowland features a high-tensile reinforced steel frame, engineered to withstand the impacts of neighborhood exploring. For reliable stopping power, the bike is equipped with a dual-braking system: a front caliper hand brake and a classic rear coaster brake. This combination allows beginners to use their feet to stop while gradually mastering hand-braking skills.

Dual braking system for maximum control and safety on every ride.

Key Features & Benefits

BMX-Inspired Design: Bold colors and a sporty frame provide a "big kid" look that children love.

Growth-Ready Comfort: The quick-release seat post allows for easy height adjustments as your child grows.

Safe & Clean: A fully enclosed chain guard protects little legs from the drivetrain and keeps clothes clean.

All-Terrain Traction: 2.125" wide pneumatic tires offer superior grip and a smooth ride on pavement or dirt paths.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get your child riding in no time. The JOYSTAR Rowland arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and simple instructions, final assembly typically takes only 20 minutes.

Assembly Guide: Quick and easy setup to get them rolling.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch: The Rowland handles neighborhood turns with ease and style.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR is committed to quality and long-term satisfaction for every young rider:

Lifetime Frame Warranty: Steel frames are covered against defects for the life of the original owner.

2-Year Component Coverage: Most non-wear parts are protected for 2 years.
